verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ אַל־ תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־ תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’al- tiṯ·ḥar bam·mə·rê·‘îm ’al- tə·qan·nê bə·‘ō·śê ‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: Of David Do not fret over those who do evil do not envy those who do wrong
verses.literalPt: Não te indignes por causa dos malfeitores, nem tenhas inveja dos que obram a iniquidade.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵe·ḥā·ṣîr mə·hê·rāh yim·mā·lū ū·ḵə·ye·req de·še yib·bō·w·lūn
verses.literal: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants
verses.literalPt: Pois cedo serão ceifados como a relva e murcharão como a erva verde.

verses.original: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭaḥ Yah·weh wa·‘ă·śêh- ṭō·wḇ šə·ḵān- ’e·reṣ ū·rə·‘êh ’ĕ·mū·nāh
verses.literal: Trust in the LORD and do good dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness
verses.literalPt: Confia em Jeová e faze o bem; habita na terra e segue a fidelidade.

verses.original: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־ לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·‘an·naḡ ‘al- Yah·weh wə·yit·ten- lə·ḵā miš·’ă·lōṯ lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Delight yourself in the LORD and He will give you the desires of your heart
verses.literalPt: Assim te deleitarás em Jeová, e ele concederá os desejos do teu coração.

verses.original: גּ֣וֹל עַל־ יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: gō·wl ‘al- Yah·weh dar·ke·ḵā ū·ḇə·ṭaḥ ‘ā·lāw wə·hū ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: Commit your way to the LORD trust in Him and He will do it
verses.literalPt: Entrega a Jeová o teu caminho; põe também nele a confiança, e ele fará,

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣî ḵā·’ō·wr ṣiḏ·qe·ḵā ū·miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā kaṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim
verses.literal: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn your justice like the noonday sun
verses.literalPt: sim, ele fará sair como a luz a tua retidão e, como o meio-dia, o teu direito.

verses.original: דּ֤וֹם׀ לַיהוָה֮ וְהִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל־ תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: dō·wm Yah·weh wə·hiṯ·ḥō·w·lêl lōw ’al- tiṯ·ḥar bə·maṣ·lî·aḥ dar·kōw bə·’îš ‘ō·śeh mə·zim·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him do not fret when men prosper in their ways when they carry out wicked schemes
verses.literalPt: Descansa em Jeová e com paciência espera por ele; não te enfades por causa daquele que prospera no seu caminho, por causa do homem que executa maus desígnios.

verses.original: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל־ תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ־ לְהָרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: he·rep̄ mê·’ap̄ wa·‘ă·zōḇ ḥê·māh ’al- tiṯ·ḥar ’aḵ- lə·hā·rê·a‘
verses.literal: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath do not fret it can only bring harm
verses.literalPt: Deixa a ira e abandona o furor; não te enfades; isso só leva à pratica do mal.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- mə·rê·‘îm yik·kā·rê·ṯūn wə·qō·wê Yah·weh hêm·māh yî·rə·šū- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For the evildoers will be cut off but those who hope in the LORD . . . will inherit the land
verses.literalPt: Pois serão exterminados os malfeitores, mas os que esperam por Jeová, esses herdarão a terra.

verses.original: וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל־ מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·wḏ mə·‘aṭ wə·’ên rā·šā‘ wə·hiṯ·bō·w·nan·tā ‘al- mə·qō·w·mōw wə·’ê·nen·nū
verses.literal: Yet a little while . . . and the wicked will be no more though you look for them they will not be found
verses.literalPt: Ainda um pouco de tempo, e não existirá o iníquo; poderás observar diligentemente o seu lugar, e ele já não é.

verses.original: וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־ אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל־ רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·nā·wîm yî·rə·šū- ’ā·reṣ wə·hiṯ·‘an·nə·ḡū ‘al- rōḇ šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity
verses.literalPt: Mas os mansos herdarão a terra e se deleitarão na abundância de paz.

verses.original: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: zō·mêm rā·šā‘ laṣ·ṣad·dîq wə·ḥō·rêq ‘ā·lāw šin·nāw
verses.literal: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them
verses.literalPt: O iníquo urde tramas contra o justo e contra ele range os dentes.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק־ ל֑וֹ כִּֽי־ רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy yiś·ḥaq- lōw kî- rā·’āh kî- yā·ḇō yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: but the Lord laughs seeing that their day is coming
verses.literalPt: Dele se rirá o Senhor, pois vê que se está aproximando o seu dia.

verses.original: חֶ֤רֶב׀ פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־ דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ pā·ṯə·ḥū rə·šā·‘îm wə·ḏā·rə·ḵū qaš·tām lə·hap·pîl ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn liṭ·ḇō·w·aḥ yiš·rê- ḏā·reḵ
verses.literal: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy to slay those whose ways are upright
verses.literalPt: Desembainham a espada os iníquos e armam o arco, para derrubarem o aflito e o necessitado, para matarem aqueles cujo caminho é reto.

verses.original: חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥar·bām tā·ḇō·w ḇə·lib·bām wə·qaš·šə·ṯō·w·ṯām tiš·šā·ḇar·nāh
verses.literal: But their swords will pierce their own hearts and their bows will be broken
verses.literalPt: A sua espada lhes entrará no coração, e os seus arcos serão quebrados.

verses.original: טוֹב־ מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- mə·‘aṭ laṣ·ṣad·dîq mê·hă·mō·wn rə·šā·‘îm rab·bîm
verses.literal: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked
verses.literalPt: Mais vale o pouco que o justo tem do que a abundância de muitos iníquos.

verses.original: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî zə·rō·w·‘ō·wṯ rə·šā·‘îm tiš·šā·ḇar·nāh wə·sō·w·mêḵ ṣad·dî·qîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: For the arms of the wicked will be broken but the LORD upholds the righteous
verses.literalPt: Pois os braços dos iníquos serão quebrados, mas Jeová sustém os justos.

verses.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏê·a‘ Yah·weh yə·mê ṯə·mî·mim wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯām lə·‘ō·w·lām tih·yeh
verses.literal: The LORD knows the days of the blameless and their inheritance will last forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Jeová conhece os dias dos íntegros, e a herança deles permanecerá para sempre.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yê·ḇō·šū bə·‘êṯ rā·‘āh ū·ḇî·mê rə·‘ā·ḇō·wn yiś·bā·‘ū
verses.literal: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed and in the days of famine they will be satisfied
verses.literalPt: Não serão envergonhados no tempo do mal, e, nos dias da fome, serão fartos.

verses.original: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀ יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî rə·šā·‘îm yō·ḇê·ḏū wə·’ō·yə·ḇê Yah·weh kî·qar kā·rîm kā·lū ḇe·‘ā·šān kā·lū
verses.literal: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields They will vanish like smoke they will fade away
verses.literalPt: Os iníquos, porém, perecerão, e os inimigos de Jeová serão como as mais belas pastagens. Eles se desfarão; em fumaça se desfarão.

verses.original: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: lō·weh rā·šā‘ wə·lō yə·šal·lêm wə·ṣad·dîq ḥō·w·nên wə·nō·w·ṯên
verses.literal: The wicked borrow and do not repay but the righteous are gracious and giving
verses.literalPt: O iníquo toma emprestado e não paga; mas o justo se compadece e dá.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mə·ḇō·rā·ḵāw yî·rə·šū ’ā·reṣ ū·mə·qul·lā·lāw yik·kā·rê·ṯū
verses.literal: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land but the cursed will be destroyed
verses.literalPt: Pois os que por ele são abençoados herdarão a terra; mas os que por ele são amaldiçoados serão exterminados.

verses.original: מֵ֭יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי־ גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh miṣ·‘ă·ḏê- ḡe·ḇer kō·w·nā·nū wə·ḏar·kōw yeḥ·pāṣ
verses.literal: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey
verses.literalPt: Por Jeová são firmados os passos do homem, em cujo caminho se deleita.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא־ יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yip·pōl lō- yū·ṭāl kî- Yah·weh sō·w·mêḵ yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Though he falls he will not be overwhelmed for the LORD is holding his hand
verses.literalPt: Ainda que caia, não ficará prostrado, pois Jeová lhe segura a mão.

verses.original: נַ֤עַר׀ הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם־ זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא־ רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: na·‘ar hā·yî·ṯî gam- zā·qan·tî wə·lō- rā·’î·ṯî ṣad·dîq ne·‘ĕ·zāḇ wə·zar·‘ōw mə·ḇaq·qeš- lā·ḥem
verses.literal: I once was young and now am old yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread
verses.literalPt: Fui mancebo, e já sou velho; não vi ainda o justo abandonado, nem a sua descendência mendigando o pão.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hay·yō·wm ḥō·w·nên ū·mal·weh wə·zar·‘ōw liḇ·rā·ḵāh
verses.literal: They are ever generous and quick to lend and their children are a blessing
verses.literalPt: Compadece-se o dia todo e empresta, e a sua descendência é abençoada.

verses.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: sūr mê·rā‘ wa·‘ă·śêh- ṭō·wḇ ū·šə·ḵōn lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Turn away from evil and do good so that you will abide forever
verses.literalPt: Desvia-te do mal e faze o bem. Assim, possuirás para sempre a tua morada.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא־ יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־ חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’ō·hêḇ miš·pāṭ wə·lō- ya·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- ḥă·sî·ḏāw lə·‘ō·w·lām niš·mā·rū wə·ze·ra‘ rə·šā·‘îm niḵ·rāṯ
verses.literal: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints They are preserved forever but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off
verses.literalPt: Pois Jeová ama a justiça e não desampara os seus santos. Eles serão preservados para sempre, mas a descendência dos iníquos será exterminada.

verses.original: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־ אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dî·qîm yî·rə·šū- ’ā·reṣ wə·yiš·kə·nū lā·‘aḏ ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever
verses.literalPt: Os justos herdarão a terra e nela habitarão para sempre.

verses.original: פִּֽי־ צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: pî- ṣad·dîq yeh·geh ḥāḵ·māh ū·lə·šō·w·nōw tə·ḏab·bêr miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom and his tongue speaks justice
verses.literalPt: A boca do justo profere a sabedoria, e a sua língua fala o juízo.

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·hāw bə·lib·bōw lō ṯim·‘aḏ ’ă·šu·rāw
verses.literal: The law of his God is in his heart his steps do not falter
verses.literalPt: A lei do seu Deus está no seu coração; não resvalarão os seus passos.

verses.original: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣō·w·p̄eh rā·šā‘ laṣ·ṣad·dîq ū·mə·ḇaq·qêš la·hă·mī·ṯō
verses.literal: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous and seek to slay them
verses.literalPt: O iníquo espreita ao justo e busca tirar-lhe a vida.

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה לֹא־ יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lō- ya·‘az·ḇen·nū ḇə·yā·ḏōw wə·lō yar·šî·‘en·nū bə·hiš·šā·p̄ə·ṭōw
verses.literal: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment
verses.literalPt: Jeová não o deixará ao seu dispor, nem o condenará, quando for julgado.

verses.original: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֨ה׀ וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qaw·wêh ’el- Yah·weh ū·šə·mōr dar·kōw wî·rō·w·mim·ḵā lā·re·šeṯ ’ā·reṣ bə·hik·kā·rêṯ rə·šā·‘îm tir·’eh
verses.literal: Wait for the LORD and keep His way and He will raise you up to inherit the land When the wicked are cut off you will see it
verses.literalPt: Espera em Jeová e segue o seu caminho, e ele te exaltará para herdares a terra. Quando os iníquos forem exterminados, tu o verás.

verses.original: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî rā·šā‘ ‘ā·rîṣ ū·miṯ·‘ā·reh kə·’ez·rāḥ ra·‘ă·nān
verses.literal: I have seen a wicked ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree
verses.literalPt: Vi o iníquo cheio de prepotência e espalhando-se como a árvore verde na terra natal.

verses.original: וַ֭יַּֽעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָֽ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr wə·hin·nêh ’ê·nen·nū wā·’ă·ḇaq·šê·hū wə·lō nim·ṣā
verses.literal: yet he passed away and was no more . . . though I searched he could not be found
verses.literalPt: Mas passei, e eis que desaparecera; procurei-o, mas ele não pôde ser encontrado.

verses.original: שְׁמָר־ תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי־ אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mār- tām ū·rə·’êh yā·šār kî- ’a·ḥă·rîṯ lə·’îš šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Consider the blameless and observe the upright for posterity awaits the man of peace
verses.literalPt: Nota o homem perfeito, considera o reto; Porque há para o homem de paz um porvir.

verses.original: וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ō·šə·‘îm niš·mə·ḏū yaḥ·dāw ’a·ḥă·rîṯ rə·šā·‘îm niḵ·rā·ṯāh
verses.literal: But the transgressors will all be destroyed the future of the wicked will be cut off
verses.literalPt: Quanto aos transgressores, serão, à uma, destruídos; a posteridade dos iníquos será exterminada.

verses.original: וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·šū·‘aṯ ṣad·dî·qîm Yah·weh mā·‘ūz·zām bə·‘êṯ ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD He is their stronghold in time of trouble
verses.literalPt: Mas a salvação dos justos vem de Jeová; ele é a sua fortaleza, no tempo da tribulação.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי־ חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya‘·zə·rêm Yah·weh way·p̄al·lə·ṭêm yə·p̄al·lə·ṭêm mê·rə·šā·‘îm wə·yō·wō·šî·‘êm kî- ḥā·sū ḇōw
verses.literal: The LORD helps and delivers them He rescues and saves them from the wicked because they take refuge in Him
verses.literalPt: Jeová ajuda-os e livra-os; livra-os dos iníquos e salva-os, porque nele se refugiaram.
